newsitem.title: USA: Ault Inc sells 1.6 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Ault Inc sells 1.6 mln common shares.

text.p: Ault Inc said Friday it sold 1.6 million common shares to the public at $6.50 each through an underwriting syndicate.
The company said it will receive net proceeds of $9.3 million while increasing its outstanding common shares to 3.7 million from 2.1 million.

Ault said it will use the proceeds to upgrade a facility in Korea, to buy a manufacturing plant in China and to reduce the debt of its Ault Korea operation. The company will also expand its manufacturing capabilities in Thailand and repay funds advanced under its revolving line of credit.
Ault makes external power conversion products.
Its stock lost 1/16 Friday to close at 7-1/16.
